pli-tv-bi-vb-pc24:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo bhikkhunīnaṃ hatthe cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā santaruttarena janapadacārikaṃ pakkamanti,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc24:1.3: tāni cīvarāni ciraṃ nikkhittāni kaṇṇakitāni honti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc24:1.7: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhunīnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc24:1.8: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc24:1.9: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo bhikkhunīnaṃ hatthe cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā santaruttarena janapadacārikaṃ pakkamissantī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc24:1.10: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo bhikkhunīnaṃ hatthe cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā santaruttarena janapadacārikaṃ pakkamantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc24:1.13: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo bhikkhunīnaṃ hatthe cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā santaruttarena janapadacārikaṃ pakkamissanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc24:1.15: evañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc24:1.16.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī pañcāhikaṃ saṅghāṭicāraṃ atikkāmeyya pācittiya”nti.
